detail: Full summary: Method note worth reusing: the project's standard 'git stash push src/' discrimination check is a NO-OP against a net-new module — stashing deletes the file so every test dies on an import error, which makes a test that pins nothing look identical to one that pins everything. Semantic mutation that keeps the module compiling is the technique that works. 28 hand-written mutants over the documented design claims found 4 real gaps that a 15-mutant pass by the module's own author had missed.
